reviews.reason: Libsecret and pkg-config installation is present before desktop build and non-server tests. Keep GitHub-hosted runners, fork ledger checks and fork branch triggers instead of upstream Blacksmith infrastructure. Server test shards remain separate. Fork-only authoring guards now block against the selected head's upstream base; the separately named live-upstream scan stays advisory so unrelated upstream drift does not fail a PR.

Libsecret and pkg-config are installed before preflight tests and Linux artifact build; ImageMagick remains installed in the build job. Keep Linux x64 AppImage-only fork releases, fork stable/nightly versioning and pruning; upstream multi-platform signing and publication do not apply. The release checkout is now recorded before dependency setup, expected assets come from the actual build, and an always-run fork outcome job verifies tag/asset publication and retains failures for release-only retry. Runner-temporary export paths stay in step scope where the runner context is valid, with one shared filename for retention and upload; an explicit verification step requires the retained receipt to be nonempty before upload, while missing upload inputs remain a hard error.
